text: player
A Recipe for an Endless Summer
Huff... Puff...
And that's the last pot...!
Inside the Gardening Club, National University of Fuuchi
Hinata Takanashi
Whew! I'm done moving them too!
These little guys are safe from the blistering sun now.
Glad I could help!
I'd never have finished this alone with so many plants to move. Thanks for the help, {var:player_nickname}.
Now for the shade nets. Once those are up, they'll be protected no matter where the sun hits.
I'm definitely a bit of a sweaty mess... but seeing them all tucked away and tidy really makes my day.
You're right. There's nothing like that "job well done" feeling...
So, it's finally the weekend...
Don't you have a shift at the cafe today?
I was just heading out! But it's been so scorching lately, I couldn't focus on work knowing my plants were baking.
Care to join me, {var:player_nickname}? Reina just got some fresh coffee beans in today!
Sounds good. I could really use a cold drink to cool off.
Then let's get moving! I'll personally make that first cup for you, {var:player_nickname}.
Reina Nanami
Oh, Hinata, you're here! Just in time. Do you think you could help me move these boxes outside?
At Éternité
Huh? Move them out? Wait, what's going on, Reina?
Hmm... Sad to say, but Éternité might be closed for the summer.
Huh?! Why?!
It's the heat and humidity. The coffee beans for our summer special were ruined during delivery.
We had other food and drinks we could've served, but just our luck – the AC just gave up on us this morning.
I'm not letting everyone work in such harsh conditions, and no one is going to sit down to eat in a sauna.
Restocking and fixing the AC will take time. {var:player_nickname}, Hinata, I'll update you when we're back. My apologies...
That look on Reina's face... I can't stop thinking about it.
She's been working for the new blend since spring. Breaking a promise to her regulars is the last thing she wanted.
Should we do something to help her out?
Yeah... I just don't know how. If only I were as clever as you, {var:player_nickname}...
Umm... {var:player_nickname}, could you help me out? Just like the way you handled things with Sprout Nursery!
Hmm, let me see...
What if we make a "summer special" that doesn't need any coffee beans at all?
Oh! That would solve the whole restocking problem!
But what should we make? Plain tea or juice might disappoint the regulars. It needs to be special.
I know! {var:player_nickname}, you have so many friends in One Han City. Let's go ask them for ideas!
Good plan. Let's see what we can find out!
Saturne
"The special flavor of summer," huh? Hahaha... You always come through with the most random questions, {var:player_nickname}.
Summer's the only thing that can melt Northland's snow, but it's hard to describe the "flavor" of that.
If I had to choose the most "honest" answer, though, I would have to say...
...this "orange soda" right here.
Wait, was that in your suit the whole time?!
And it's just the basic kind from any old vending machine...
A great businessman knows the best investments are often the most cost-effective ones.
Real treasure is found in the simple things that trigger precious memories. When you've lived through the snow, you appreciate the sweetness.
And who knows? An orange soda mixed by {var:player_nickname} might be something truly special.
Haruna Igarashi
The flavor of summer? Popsicles, obviously! Especially when you split one with a friend!
And what's the flavor?
Peach is sweet, Chocolate is so rich... My tummy loves them all! Don't make me pick!
But I know this: if it's a good drink, it'll be an even better popsicle!
I'm gotta go find the kitties! {var:player_nickname}, don't forget, you're coming with me next time!
Yui Yagi
Good morning, senpai.
Good morning!
(whisper) Are we really asking Yui?
Shake head
Shake head faster!
It's funny how tense you look, senpai. You're here to ask about the food, right?//nI'd recommend the Yam & Fish Soda.
...Noted. Thanks!
Alright, we've got a list! Orange soda and popsicles... total summer classics!
But Éternité is closed. Where can we actually do the mixing?
No need to bother anyone else. Let's just go to my place!
To your place?
Are you sure?
It's fine, follow me!
Welcome! Please, come in!
Thank goodness for air conditioning... I'm alive again...
The house smells faintly of flowers.
We've been out in the sun too long. Here, {var:player_nickname}, let me help you with that sweat.
It's nice and cool inside. {var:player_nickname}, feel free to look around and rest before we start!
Hehe, it's like natural perfume, smells refreshing, right? I'm glad you like it, {var:player_nickname}!
{var:player_nickname}, feel free to look around! Make yourself at home!
Her place looks like a typical home, aside from a jungle of potted plants on the tables...
Also, even with the AC on low, the room feels surprisingly cool...
How is it, {var:player_nickname}? Pretty cool in here, right?
It is... I can barely feel the summer heat. Is the AC even doing that much?
Hehe, that's because my "green helpers" are working their magic!
This way! I'll introduce you to them!
Ta-da!
Hinata, you have... so many plants in your yard!
Yep! They're my pride and joy. I've been waiting for the day I could finally show you around.
I tell them everything – about school, the cafe... and {var:player_nickname}...
Ah! I-I mean... they provide shade and keep the air fresh and cool. Plus, aren't they just pretty?
{var:player_nickname}... what do you think? Do you like it?
Check out the plants
Check out Hinata's face
N-not me! I mean the plants in the yard...!
They look so healthy. You've really poured your heart into this, haven't you?
Wait... Are these little tags on the plants? Some old, some new, and some are even laminated. But that's not your writing, is it?
My grandma wrote those. I've saved them all since I first started gardening with her.
This one's from my 5th birthday. The other reminds me not to overwater the ball cactus...
Hmm? That bunny succulent you brought back has a tag too. The color is different. Is it special?
Oh! That's...!
Take a closer look
Wait for Hinata to finish
"I hope that someday I can..."
H-hey! No peeking!
At least... not now. Maybe another time!
Phew... Okay, tour's over. We have a drink to make! To the kitchen, {var:player_nickname}!
Right, let's get to work.
I'd love to see more...
Ugh...
I tried making it more bubbly, which completely washed out the flavor...
Then I added orange zest and an orange popsicle as a garnish. It looks nice, but now it has this bitter taste I can't fix...
I feel like I've tried everything I can think of, but it's just not working...
It's okay... at least you did your best...
I just... I really wanted this to work.
But no matter what I do, I just can't find that "flavor of summer" we're looking for...
Yeah, it feels like something is missing...
Is there really nothing we can do until the next coffee beans arrive...?
Maybe... we're trying too hard to find other people's "flavor of summer" instead of ours?
What's your idea of summer?
What's your favorite summer drink?
Oh, me? Hmm...
Besides the drinks on family trips... my grandma used to make me this cold drink when I was little.
On those hot summer evenings with the cicadas buzzing... I'd sit on my little chair and watch her work in the garden.
She'd hum these old songs I didn't know while rinsing the fresh-picked mint and basil. The whole yard would smell like them.
Just when I was about to nod off from the heat, she'd hand me that drink...
One sip of it felt like finding a patch of cool moss on a burning road, and just lying there to cool off...
That's a very "Hinata" way to describe it.
I don't know why, but that's the image that stuck. It was herbal and refreshingly cool just like the moss...
But... don't all grandmas make drinks like that? It's probably nothing special...
No, not all of them.
Wait, really?!
There's the clueless Hinata we know...
Haha... Good thing you're here... otherwise I'd be making a fool of myself again.
Still, that drink sounds unique, delicious, and simple... That's it! The perfect "summer special" Éternité needs!! Let's try to recreate it!
Really? But... I don't have a recipe. I have no idea how she actually made it...
We don't need a recipe if we have your memories. Let's work through it one step at a time!
You said she washed the fresh mint and basil... What was her secret for getting that aroma out?
Now that you mention it, I do remember a bit of what she did to them.
She didn't chop them. She'd put the basil and mint in her palm and give them a light "clap"... That's how she woke up the aroma!
There's the first step!
The glass was always icy and full of bubbles... so we need chilled soda water!
And the sweetness... she told me once it wasn't sugar, but I've totally forgotten what she used...
Hinata?
Actually... Grandma left me a wooden box. She said her most precious things were inside.
Sounds like a treasure box... Maybe the secret to the drink is in there!
Hehe, I think so too. I was a bit scared to go through her things before... I didn't want to get sad again.
But now, I've realized that remembering her doesn't have to be sad... What she left behind for me wasn't meant to be sorrow, but the joy within those memories.
{var:player_nickname}, let's open it together.
It's... dried mint, basil, and... stevia leaves? That must be the source of the sweetness! And there's a note underneath...
{var:player_nickname}, I...
It's okay.
I'm right here with you.
Okay...
Note
"To my dearest Hinata, who always gets woozy in the summer heat – "
"If you ever miss my special drink, try this: 5 spearmint leaves, 3 sweet basil leaves, 2 stevia leaves. Clap them 'awake,' then add chilled soda and lemon."
"I want you to learn this drink. That way, I'll always be by your side, and we'll share another joyful, unforgettable summer."
She knew that eventually, some summer afternoon would lead me right back to this drink.
I think... she wanted you to move forward. She left you a map to find her and recall the beautiful memories again.
Alright, {var:player_nickname}. Let's make it!
This time, I'm going to make "our" summer special using Grandma's recipe, so everyone can feel the same joy!
Basil, stevia, lemon, mint... add the soda, a quick stir...
All done! {var:player_nickname}, can you... do the honors?
Take a sip
Wow. That's amazing. It's completely different from anything in a store.
R-really? Let me try it too!
This is it! It tastes just like Grandma's! We did it, {var:player_nickname}!
You're squeezing me too hard...!
The drink is going to spill...!
Whoops! Sorry, sorry! I just got a little excited...
Since you liked it too, let's go talk to Reina!
Let's go!
Hmm... such a unique flavor. It's so refreshing. This could actually work as our new special...
Yes!
But... there's still one problem.
Hmm... the technician came by. He has to order a specific part for the compressor, so the AC can only run on low power now.
Oh no... how unfortunate...
We've got the drink, but it's still a sauna in here. We'll pass out before we can serve anyone.
And no customers will stick around to finish their drink...
You know, when we were at your place, it felt cool even with the AC on low...
We can use the same setup here!
Time to bring in your "green helpers"!
Of course! The plants! Transpiration will cool the air down and increase the humidity!
{var:player_nickname}, let's help Reina one more time!
If we bring some plants from the club and my house, it'll cool the place down and give it a fresh look!
Hmm... a "green" renovation?
That's a very "Hinata" idea. Bold, sweet, and unique.
If it's not too much trouble... please, give it a try! I'd love to see how it looks!
I've got a bit more left in the tank.
This is for the cafe and all of us!
I'm totally spent...
Didn't we just do this earlier today...?
Wow! The cafe looks just like a garden now! The temperature's still up, but it's already feeling fresher and I'm feeling better already!
Hinata, {var:player_nickname}, thank you so much!
We're all set! Now we just wait for the plants to work their magic.
Great job, {var:player_nickname}. Here, Reina and I made these sandwiches while you were finishing up.
Thanks for the sandwiches!
Delicious! I feel like myself again...
Now, let's take a group photo!
One, two... three! To the new summer special and our "green AC"!
Hehe... I couldn't have done it without you!
Glad to help.
No big deal, really!
A few days later...
Customer A
This new drink is so refreshing... and it's way cooler in here.
Customer B
Whoa! It's like a garden party in here! And it makes a great photo spot! I'm so glad I followed Sprout Nursery's recommendation!
Customer C
The new drink is totally different from the old ones, but it's actually amazing!
The customers are raving about it! You two really saved the day!
Hehe...
We did it, {var:player_nickname}! I'm so happy everyone likes Grandma's drink. And Reina is smiling again!
You're the one who made it happen.
No, {var:player_nickname} was the one who asked around, thought of the plants, and... helped me find Grandma's recipe.
It was a team effort!
Here's to more teamwork!
Phew... Shift's over.
Everyone loves our "summer special," but I think...
That first glass we shared... that was the only one that felt "special" to me.
Because of the memories of your grandma?
Because it was the first one we got right?
Hehe... maybe.
But maybe it's also because the air here makes all the stress and worry just... disappear.
I used to feel a bit sad when I thought about Grandma in the summer. Like those days were gone forever.
But today, watching the bubbles rise and the ice clinking in the glass...
I feel like those memories aren't something to be sad about. They've just changed into something new and come back to me.
Something new?
Yeah. It's not just that one dusty memory of a hot summer anymore.
It's a brand new summer where {var:player_nickname} helped me, and we made a mess of the kitchen, and finally sat here in the breeze...
I love this feeling... I wish this moment could last just a little longer.
Then let's enjoy the evening breeze a bit longer.
Don't worry, we've still got ice in our glasses.
Yeah.
The setting sun filters through the layers of leaves, painting a forest in the glass and casting soft, dappled light across her face.
The best fruits are always hidden under the leaves, waiting for someone who's actually looking.
I finally found that "hidden fruit" I couldn't reach all these years, and it's all because of you.
Cheers, {var:player_nickname}! Thank you for helping me find my way back to that summer...
And thank you for giving me such a wonderful new memory!
That was a bit embarrassing to say... hehe...
Hinata raises her glass toward the setting sun. The bubbles sparkle in the golden light as if capturing the moment.
Raise the glass.
The two glasses clink together with a clear, crisp sound.
Within the bubbles, the flavors of two different summers become one.
I didn't realize you were so interested in my plants, {var:player_nickname}...!
Then I'll introduce you to every single one!
I brought my camera too! I've always thought you'd look great with plants. Can I take a few photos?
How long will this take?
You're really feeling it, huh?
It'll be quick, I promise! Just need the right angle, focus, and lighting!
Of course, it's a special occasion! {var:player_nickname}, try to look natural. Imagine you're a plant soaking up the sun!
Oh, that "huh?" look is perfect! You look just like that lithops. Very adorable!
Now, move a bit to the left, right next to that mint!
I'm starting to feel like a specimen in a greenhouse...
That's a natural expression! Now one more with the spider plant!
The sun's moving. Let's try a different angle!
This angle is great for a duo. The bunny succulent is resting, so {var:player_nickname}, let's pose like we're waking it up together!
Uh, isn't this a bit close?!
Wait, where did the tag on the bunny succulent go?
Oh! I-I'm sure it's just around here somewhere... but anyway!
By September, the bunny succulent will look like little bunnies again! We'll have to take another photo from this angle then, like we actually woke it up. It'll be so much fun!
Okay, now check this one! It's a perfect background for us, too. Its scientific name is actually...
The "quick" photoshoot continued as Hinata kept finding one "perfect angle" after another...
Hehe... I didn't realize it had gotten so late... Sorry, I got a bit carried away...
But you looked so good with the plants, {var:player_nickname}. I can't bring myself to delete a single photo!
Wait, what time is it?! Oh no!
Did we... completely forget about the "summer special" drink?!
It took you that long to realize?!
I couldn't stop you even if I tried...
Ugh... But a promise is a promise! I'll definitely figure out the drink by tomorrow, I swear!
